claim_type: finite-blocklength achievability threshold with converse envelope
limitations: Deletion-only scope: only the deletion half of the Li-He-Tang insdel machinery is exercised; insertion/substitution branches are out of scope. The 0.68 bound is a family codebook-counting envelope (log2(1290556)/32 ≈ 0.6344 < 0.68), not a general channel converse. Rate 0.625 uses an explicit 2^20 integer-bit subcode of the 1290555-word alphabet.
provenance: Independent SCOPE audit attempt 1 of lane-1141 research (2026-09-07-first-light-01); computation reproduced via output/artifacts/ledger.py; literature cross-checked via scope_literature_search (fused SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref) plus full fetch of Abroshan et al. arXiv:1701.06341v4 and Error Correction Zoo VT entry.
record_title: Finite-Blocklength Jigsaw Ledger for the Li-He-Tang Marker-Codeword-Marker VT Family on Segmented Single-Deletion Channels (n=32, N=1024)
